# Xdatrys

> Xdatrys makes photo maps for travellers: the top sights of each place, ranked by what travellers search for, where to stand for the best photo or selfie, and simple tips for your smartphone. 3 spots on every map are free.

## About and membership
- [About Xdatrys](https://xdatrys.com/about/): who we are and how the maps help you plan the sightseeing day and get the photo
- [Pricing](https://xdatrys.com/pricing/): free (3 spots on every map), Explorer $9.99 a month or $59.99 a year (every spot and the app), Pro coming soon
- [FAQ](https://xdatrys.com/faq/): common questions about the maps, the app and membership
